source: 外研社选择性必修第二册 Unit 5 同主题完形(蜜蜂为何重要/护林员清除害兽/金丝猴越冬保护/咸海消失/珊瑚礁危机/学生护湿地反思)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Why Bees Matter
passages.text: Bees may be small, but they play a (1)____ part in keeping our world alive. As they move from flower to flower, they carry pollen and help plants to produce fruit and (2)____. Scientists believe that a (4)____ of causes, including the loss of wild flowers and the use of chemicals, is to (5)____. If bees were to (6)____ out completely, other insects could not easily take their place, because so many kinds of crops (7)____ on them. The good news is that ordinary people can (8)____. passages.text: My name is Sam, and I work as a wildlife ranger on a small, windy (1)____ far out at sea. passages.title: Saving the Golden Monkey
passages.text: High in the mountains of central China lives the rare golden snub-nosed (1)____, an animal found in very few places on Earth. Thanks to their patient (6)____, the number of monkeys has slowly (7)____, and today there are far more than there were in the 1980s. passages.title: The Lost Sea
passages.text: The Aral Sea was once one of the largest lakes in the world, full of fish and surrounded by busy fishing (1)____. passages.title: The Rainforests of the Sea
